description: This file contains functions and classes for converting Spark DataFrame partitions into Arrow IPC format streams, including a class implementing the __arrow_c_stream__ protocol for efficient partition streaming.

classes.name: SparkArrowCStreamer
classes.description: Implements the __arrow_c_stream__ protocol for Spark DataFrame partitions, allowing streaming of Arrow IPC data without materializing all partitions at once.

methods.name: _get_arrow_array_partition_stream
methods.description: Returns an iterator over Arrow RecordBatches for each DataFrame partition, serializing them into Arrow IPC format.

methods.name: __arrow_c_stream__
methods.description: Returns an Arrow C stream for the DataFrame partitions, enabling efficient data transfer.
